

# 1. nonrisk data
```{r}

library(vegan)
library(tidyverse)

pla_asvs <- read.csv("pla_nonrisk_bacteria_asvs.csv", row.names = 1)
envdata <- read.csv("envdata.csv", row.names = 1)

pla_asvs <- pla_asvs[, rownames(envdata)]

head(pla_asvs)

pla_asvs <- pla_asvs[rowSums(pla_asvs) > 0, ]
pla_asvs <- t(pla_asvs)

dist_matrix <- vegdist(pla_asvs, method = "bray")

pcoa_result <- cmdscale(dist_matrix, eig = TRUE, k = 10)

pcoa_axes <- as.data.frame(pcoa_result$points)
colnames(pcoa_axes) <- paste0("Axis", 1:ncol(pcoa_axes))


explained_variance <- pcoa_result$eig[1:10] / sum(pcoa_result$eig) * 100
explained_variance

write.csv(pcoa_axes, "pla_nonrisk_bac_asvs_10PC.csv", row.names = T, quote = F)

```

# 3. VPA
```{r}
# bacteria
library(vegan)
library(tidyverse)

bacteria <- read.csv("pla_nonrisk_bac_asvs_10PC.csv", row.names = 1)
fungi <- read.csv("pla_fung_asvs_10PC.csv", row.names = 1)
algae <- read.csv("pla_algae_asvs_10PC.csv", row.names = 1)
envdata <- read.csv("envdata_10PC.csv", row.names = 1)
risk_asvs <- read.csv("pla_risk_bacteria_asvs.csv", row.names = 1)
risk_asvs <- t(risk_asvs)

bacteria <- bacteria[order(rownames(bacteria)), ]
fungi <- fungi[order(rownames(fungi)), ]
algae <- algae[order(rownames(algae)), ]
envdata <- envdata[order(rownames(envdata)), ]
risk_asvs <- risk_asvs[order(rownames(risk_asvs)), ]

stopifnot(
  all(rownames(bacteria) == rownames(fungi)),
  all(rownames(fungi) == rownames(algae)),
  all(rownames(algae) == rownames(envdata)),
  all(rownames(envdata)  == rownames(risk_asvs))
)

bacteria <- as.data.frame(bacteria)
fungi <- as.data.frame(fungi)
algae <- as.data.frame(algae)
envdata <- as.data.frame(envdata)

# 计算 risk_asvs 的距离矩阵
dist_risk <- vegdist(risk_asvs, method = "bray")

vpa <- varpart(dist_risk, bacteria, fungi, algae, envdata)

vpa$adj.R.square[vpa$adj.R.square < 0] <- 0

print(vpa)

plot(vpa, bg = c("#ECD1D1", "#ABD7EC", "#FFDD8E", "#BCE7E0"))

```
